name: @arenaswap/extension
description: ArenaSwap browser extension — automatically flip to the most exciting game

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @arenaswap/powerscore && npm run build --workspace @arenaswap/core && wxt build
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build --workspace @arenaswap/powerscore && npm run build --workspace @arenaswap/core && wxt build --browser firefox --mv3
